questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA) is located in which state?
questions.explanation: FUTA is located in Akure, the capital city of Ondo State, in south-western Nigeria.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: In what year was the Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA) established?
questions.explanation: FUTA was established in 1981 as one of the second generation of Nigerian federal universities dedicated specifically to technology education.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: FUTA was established as part of a federal government initiative to create universities with a special focus on which area of study?
questions.explanation: FUTA was created as a specialist federal university of technology, focused on producing graduates in engineering, science, and technology-related fields.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Akure, the host city of FUTA, serves as the capital of which Nigerian state?
questions.explanation: Akure is the capital and largest city of Ondo State.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Ondo State, where FUTA is situated, is particularly well known in Nigeria for the large-scale production of which cash crop?
questions.explanation: Ondo State is one of Nigeria's leading cocoa-producing states, with cocoa long forming a major part of the state's agricultural economy.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following ethnic/sub-ethnic groups forms the majority of the indigenous population of Ondo State?
questions.explanation: Ondo State's indigenous population is predominantly Yoruba, including the Akoko, Ondo, Ikale, Ilaje, and Owo sub-groups.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is a well-known indigenous festival celebrated among the Yoruba communities of Ondo State?
questions.explanation: The Igogo festival, celebrated in Owo, is among the notable indigenous festivals of Ondo State's Yoruba communities.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which body of water forms part of the southern boundary of Ondo State?
questions.explanation: Ondo State has a coastline along the Atlantic Ocean in its southern riverine areas, including areas near Ilaje.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which regulatory body is responsible for accrediting academic programmes in Nigerian universities, including FUTA?
options: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB)
The Federal Ministry of Education alone, with no separate agency
questions.explanation: The NUC is the regulatory body responsible for approving and accrediting academic programmes offered by Nigerian universities, ensuring they meet minimum quality standards.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary role of a Vice-Chancellor in a Nigerian university, such as FUTA?
options: Serving as the elected student union president
Managing only the university's sports facilities
Serving as the chief executive and academic head of the university
Serving as an external auditor of the university's accounts
questions.explanation: A Vice-Chancellor is the chief executive and principal academic officer of a Nigerian university, responsible for its overall administration and academic direction.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which arm of government in Nigeria is primarily responsible for interpreting laws and administering justice?
questions.explanation: The Judiciary is the arm of government responsible for interpreting laws and adjudicating disputes, distinct from the law-making Legislature and law-enforcing Executive.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for the Nigerian legislative chamber that represents individual constituencies at the federal level, alongside the Senate?
questions.explanation: The House of Representatives, together with the Senate, forms Nigeria's bicameral National Assembly, with members representing federal constituencies.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following countries shares a land border with Nigeria?
questions.explanation: Nigeria shares land borders with Cameroon, Niger, Chad, and Benin Republic; Ghana, South Africa, and Kenya are not bordering countries.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the longest river in Africa?
questions.explanation: The River Nile, flowing through north-eastern Africa, is the longest river on the continent.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary function of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC)?
options: Organising and supervising elections in Nigeria
questions.explanation: INEC is Nigeria's independent body responsible for organising, conducting, and supervising elections at the federal and state levels.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for pure oxygen gas?
questions.explanation: Oxygen gas exists naturally as a diatomic molecule, represented by the chemical formula O2.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which planet in our solar system is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars is often called the 'Red Planet' because of the reddish appearance caused by iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is Cote d'Ivoire's national football team commonly nicknamed?
questions.explanation: Cote d'Ivoire's senior men's national football team is popularly known as the Elephants, distinct from Ghana's Black Stars and Nigeria's Super Eagles.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which international body is primarily responsible for setting global standards and rules for international trade?
questions.explanation: The WTO is the international organisation specifically responsible for establishing and enforcing global rules governing trade between nations.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for a system of government headed by a king or queen whose powers are limited by a constitution?
questions.explanation: A constitutional monarchy is a system in which a monarch serves as head of state, but their powers are limited and defined by a constitution, unlike an absolute monarchy.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary function of the Nigerian Police Force?
options: Maintaining law and order and enforcing criminal law
questions.explanation: The Nigerian Police Force is the primary law enforcement agency responsible for maintaining public order and enforcing criminal law across the country.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a non-communicable disease?
questions.explanation: Diabetes is a non-communicable (chronic) disease, unlike tuberculosis, cholera, and measles, which are infectious diseases.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the smallest country in the world by land area?
questions.explanation: Vatican City, an independent city-state enclaved within Rome, Italy, is the smallest country in the world by land area.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary role of the executive arm of government?
questions.explanation: The executive arm, headed by a President or Governor, is primarily responsible for implementing and enforcing the laws made by the legislature.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which vitamin deficiency is most commonly associated with the bone disease rickets?
questions.explanation: Rickets is a disease resulting from a deficiency of Vitamin D, which is essential for calcium absorption and healthy bone development.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for the total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a given period?
questions.explanation: GDP specifically measures the value of goods and services produced within a country's borders, regardless of the nationality of the producers.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Nigerian author wrote the celebrated play 'Death and the King's Horseman'?
questions.explanation: Wole Soyinka, Nigeria's first Nobel laureate in Literature, wrote the celebrated play 'Death and the King's Horseman.'

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What does the abbreviation 'NAFDAC' stand for in the Nigerian context?
options: National Authority for Food, Drugs, and Cosmetics
Nigerian Agency for Food and Drug Coordination
National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control
National Association for Drug and Chemical Control
questions.explanation: NAFDAC regulates and controls the manufacture, importation, and sale of food, drugs, and related products in Nigeria.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for a persistent, sustained rise in the general price level of goods and services in an economy?
questions.explanation: Inflation describes an ongoing, generalised increase in prices across an economy, the opposite of deflation.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary aim of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA)?
options: Restricting all trade between African nations
Creating a single market for goods and services across African countries to boost intra-African trade
questions.explanation: AfCFTA aims to create a single continental market for goods and services, boosting intra-African trade by reducing tariffs and other trade barriers among member states.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is a key function of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) relating to currency?
options: Issuing and regulating the country's currency (the Naira)
Setting the retail price of consumer goods
questions.explanation: One of the CBN's core functions is the sole authority to issue and regulate Nigeria's legal tender currency, the Naira.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary purpose of the World Health Organization (WHO)?
options: Coordinating international public health and disease control efforts
questions.explanation: The WHO is a United Nations agency specifically responsible for coordinating international public health matters, including disease prevention and control.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is the largest producer of crude oil in Africa, based on long-established historical ranking?
questions.explanation: Nigeria has long been recognised as one of Africa's leading crude oil producers, historically ranking as the continent's largest producer for extended periods.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for the practice of a country restricting imports through tariffs or quotas to protect domestic industries?
questions.explanation: Protectionism refers to government policies that restrict international trade, such as tariffs and quotas, to shield domestic industries from foreign competition.
